metaDescription: Add MessMate to your iPhone or Android home screen in a few taps. Step-by-step guide for Safari, Chrome and Samsung Internet.
title: MessMate on your <accent>home screen</accent>
subtitle: No app store needed. Install MessMate straight from your browser. It opens full screen, loads fast and sits next to your other apps.

action.installNowDesc: One tap. Your browser will ask you to confirm.
action.successToast: MessMate installed! Find it on your home screen.
action.dismissedToast: Install cancelled. You can try again anytime.
action.installedDesc: You're all set. Open MessMate from your home screen anytime.
action.iosDesc: Apple doesn't let websites install themselves, so you'll add MessMate from the Share menu. It takes about 10 seconds.
action.inappTitle: Open this page in your browser first
action.inappDescIos: You're inside another app's browser (like Facebook or Messenger), which can't install apps. Copy the link and open it in Safari.
action.inappDescAndroid: You're inside another app's browser (like Facebook or Messenger), which can't install apps. Open this page in Chrome to continue.
action.manualDesc: Follow the steps below. It only takes a few taps.
action.desktopTitle: Open this page on your phone
action.desktopDesc: MessMate works best installed on your phone. Copy the link and open it on your phone. On a computer, Chrome and Edge also show an install icon in the address bar.
action.unsupportedDescAndroid: MessMate installs properly from Chrome or Samsung Internet. {browser} isn't supported, so open this page in Chrome (or Samsung Internet) to continue.
action.unsupportedDescIos: On iPhone, MessMate installs from Safari or Chrome. {browser} isn't supported, so open this page in Safari to continue.
action.copyHintAndroid: Or copy the link, then paste it into Chrome's address bar.
action.copyHintIos: Copy the link, open Safari and paste it into the address bar.

guideSubtitle: Pick your phone and browser. We've already selected the one you're using.

s1.title: Tap the Share button
s1.body: In Safari, tap the Share icon (a square with an arrow pointing up) in the toolbar at the bottom of the screen.

s2.title: Choose “Add to Home Screen”
s2.body: Scroll down the menu and tap “Add to Home Screen”. If you don't see it, tap “Edit Actions” and add it.

s3.title: Tap “Add”
s3.body: Keep the name “MessMate” and tap “Add” in the top-right corner.

s4.title: Open MessMate
s4.body: MessMate is now on your home screen. Tap the icon to open it full screen, just like an app.

s1.title: Tap the Share button
s1.body: In Chrome, tap the Share icon on the right side of the address bar at the top. Requires iOS 16.4 or newer.

s2.title: Choose “Add to Home Screen”
s2.body: Scroll down the menu and tap “Add to Home Screen”.

s3.title: Tap “Add”
s3.body: Keep the name “MessMate” and tap “Add” in the top-right corner.

s4.title: Open MessMate
s4.body: MessMate is now on your home screen. Tap the icon to open it full screen.

s1.title: Open the menu
s1.body: In Chrome, tap the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner.

s2.title: Tap “Install and create shortcut”
s2.body: Scroll down the menu and tap “Install and create shortcut”. On older Chrome versions it's called “Add to home screen” or “Install app”.

s3.title: Tap “Install”
s3.body: Confirm by tapping “Install”. Chrome adds the app in a few seconds.

s4.title: Open MessMate
s4.body: Find MessMate on your home screen or in the app drawer and tap to open.

s1.title: Open the menu
s1.body: In Samsung Internet, tap the menu button (☰) at the bottom right. Tip: if you see a download icon in the address bar, tap that to install in one step.

s2.title: Tap “Add page to”
s2.body: In the menu, tap “Add page to”.

s5.title: Open MessMate
s5.body: MessMate is now on your home screen. Tap the icon to open it.

fullscreen.title: Full screen
fullscreen.body: No address bar, so more room for your meals and accounts.

fast.title: Opens instantly
fast.body: One tap from your home screen, no typing the address.

offline.title: Works on weak internet
offline.body: Recently viewed pages stay available when the network drops.

light.title: Tiny size
light.body: Uses almost no storage compared to a store app.

safe.a: Yes. It's the same MessMate website, saved to your home screen by your own browser. It can't access anything on your phone that the website can't.

update.q: Do I need to update it?
update.a: No. The installed app always loads the latest version automatically.

account.q: Will I need to sign in again?
account.a: Usually not on Android. On iPhone, the home-screen app keeps its own session, so you may need to sign in once.

uninstall.a: Long-press the MessMate icon and choose “Remove App” (iPhone) or “Uninstall” (Android), just like any other app.
